faqs.question: UK visit visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Online application, funds, ties to Pakistan, purpose evidence, and biometrics. SK Immigration prepares the full file from PKR 30,000.

faqs.question: How much bank balance for UK visit visa?
faqs.answer: Enough for your itinerary plus ongoing Pakistan commitments — UKVI looks at credibility, not a fixed public number. We review statements honestly.

faqs.question: Do I need a sponsor for UK visit?
faqs.answer: Not always. Family/business visits often use invitations; tourists can self-fund with hotels.

faqs.question: Can I study on UK visitor visa?
faqs.answer: Only short recreational courses within visitor rules — not full degrees. Use Student visa for CAS programs.

faqs.question: UK visit visa refusal reasons?
faqs.answer: Insufficient ties, unclear funds, credibility issues, or immigration history concerns are common.

faqs.question: Does SK guarantee UK visit visa?
faqs.answer: No. UKVI decides. We prepare strong, truthful applications.

faqs.answer: From PKR 30,000 for consultancy packaging. Official fees separate.

body:
United Kingdom visit visa from Pakistan

SK Immigration Services helps Pakistani applicants prepare United Kingdom visit visa files for tourism, family, business visitor, short courses under visitor rules. Embassies decide outcomes — we prepare complete, honest applications.

Who this page is for

Candidates searching for United Kingdom visit visa requirements from Pakistan, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, refusal reasons and how to apply — with SK Immigration as their consultant in Rawalpindi.

Requirements

  • Valid passport and online GOV.UK application
  • Proof of funds covering the trip without unauthorized work
  • Employment / business / study ties in Pakistan
  • Invitation letter for family or business visits when applicable
  • Travel plan and accommodation
  • TB test only if required by category (usually not for short standard visitor)

Process — how to apply

  1. Purpose and risk assessment
  2. Document and bank review
  3. Online form coaching
  4. VAC biometrics prep
  5. Decision tracking

Documents checklist

  • Passport and photos
  • Bank statements (typically 6 months)
  • Salary slips / NTN / business docs
  • Invitation + sponsor status docs if invited
  • Property / family evidence
  • Cover letter

Fees

SK from PKR 30,000. UKVI and VAC fees separate.

Processing time / timeline

Often 3–8 weeks; priority services cost extra and are not a guarantee.

Common mistakes & refusal risks

  • Vague “tourism” with no plan or funds
  • Sponsor claiming support without evidence
  • Inconsistent employment history
  • Previous overstays unexplained
  • Intending to work or switch illegally

Related services

All visit visas · Work permits · Visa appointments · Study visas · Free consultation

UK Standard Visitor — credibility framework UKVI actually uses

UKVI does not publish a magic bank-balance number for every Pakistani tourist. Officers weigh purpose + funds + ties to Pakistan + immigration history. A large balance with no job, no family anchors and a vague itinerary still fails.

PillarEvidence examplesWeak version
PurposeFamily invite, business meetings, tourist day plan“Tourism” with blank calendar
Funds6-month statements matching trip cost + ongoing life in PKBorrowed lump sum week before apply
TiesJob letter + leave, business NTN, dependents, propertyUnemployed with no return story
HistoryPrior visas used correctlyUnexplained refusals / overstays

Where Pakistanis apply (UK)

UK visitor applications are filed online on GOV.UK, then biometrics at VFS Global UKVI centres in Pakistan (Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore — verify live list). SK Immigration sequences documents before you pay UKVI fees.

Invitation letters — help, not a stamp

An invitation from a UK resident helps family/business visits when the sponsor’s status and address are documented. It does not replace your own funds/ties analysis. Tourists can self-fund with hotels — honesty beats fake sponsors.

Visitor vs Student — do not mix

Short recreational courses may fit visitor rules; full degrees need a Student visa + CAS. Using a visit application to “enter and switch” is a refusal and ban risk. See visit vs student.

Fees and timing

  • SK Immigration visit packaging from PKR 30,000
  • UKVI + VAC fees separate — confirm on GOV.UK before payment
  • Often 3–8 weeks; priority is paid speed, not approval

Cover letter structure that helps UKVI

  • Who you are and what you do in Pakistan
  • Exact travel dates and where you stay
  • Who pays and how the bank trail shows it
  • Why you will return (job, business, dependents)

Pakistan refusal themes

  • Insufficient ties after prior refusals
  • Sponsor claiming support without evidence
  • Tourism with no plan or unrealistic duration
  • Prior overstays or credibility interview issues

UK visit vs UK student — pick the correct route

If your real goal is a degree or CAS program, do not force a visitor file. Use the UK study visa lander. Visitor files must show a temporary trip and strong return ties.

What SK Immigration prepares for UKVI credibility

  • Purpose letter that matches tickets, hotels and invite (if any)
  • Employment / business proof that continues in Pakistan
  • Bank statements that explain large deposits honestly
  • Travel history and previous UKVI outcomes (if any)
